items.title: Super Graphic Spectacular review – Chappell Roan dazzles at her gloriously gay mini-festival
items.summary: Shrine Auditorium, Los Angeles With performances by Christina Aguilera, Lola Young and Tinashe, the pop star brings a colorful vision to life in support of LGBTQ+ charities At Chappell Roan ’s Super Graphic Spectacular, the sincerely camp pop star imagines a world where the most vulnerable among us aren’t wielded as scapegoats, and where life can be good, so long as we are good to one another. That better world takes the form of a two-night extravaganza at Los Angeles’s Shrine Auditorium, part kiki ball, part fabulous revue, celebrating the first anniversary of the Midwest Princess Project , the nonprofit Roan founded in 2025 to support transgender youth and LGBTQ+ communities. items.title: Christa Pike’s IV team warned vein might be ‘blowing’ before failed execution
items.summary: New account from Pike’s lawyer suggests team was racked by doubts even before pentobarbital began to flow The Tennessee execution team tasked with setting an intravenous line in the arms of the death row prisoner Christa Pike through which she could be injected with a lethal dose of pentobarbital repeatedly warned that her vein might be “blowing”, before they went ahead with the procedure, her lawyer has revealed.
